----- components/Chip.tsx -----
// Generated by Lakar from component "Chip". Import tokens.css once in your app.
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import styles from './Chip.module.css';

export type ChipProps = {
  label?: string;
  open?: boolean;
  detail?: boolean;
  tone?: "info" | "triangle-alert" | "circle-check";
  arah?: "row" | "column";
  rata?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Chip({ label = "Chip", open = false, detail = true, tone = "info", arah = "row", rata = "center", className, style }: ChipProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${{ row: { start: styles.chip, center: styles.chip2, end: styles.chip3 }[rata], column: { start: styles.chip4, center: styles.chip5, end: styles.chip6 }[rata] }[arah]}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      <div className={styles.iconLucideInfo}>
        {tone === "info" && (
          <svg className={styles.iconLucideInfoSvg} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#0369A1" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
            <path d="M12 16v-4" />
            <path d="M12 8h.01" />
          </svg>
        )}
        {tone === "triangle-alert" && (
          <svg className={styles.iconLucideInfoSvg2} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#0369A1" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <path d="m21.73 18-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.48 0l-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.73-3" />
            <path d="M12 9v4" />
            <path d="M12 17h.01" />
          </svg>
        )}
        {tone === "circle-check" && (
          <svg className={styles.iconLucideInfoSvg3} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#0369A1" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
            <path d="m16 9-5.5 5.5L8 12" />
          </svg>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.label}>
        {label}
      </div>
      {open && (
        <div className={{ row: styles.detail, column: styles.detail2 }[arah]}>
          <div className={styles.iconLucideInfo2}>
            {tone === "info" && (
              <svg className={styles.iconLucideInfoSvg4} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#0369A1" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
                <path d="M12 16v-4" />
                <path d="M12 8h.01" />
              </svg>
            )}
            {tone === "triangle-alert" && (
              <svg className={styles.iconLucideInfoSvg5} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#0369A1" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                <path d="m21.73 18-8-14a2 2 0 0 0-3.48 0l-8 14A2 2 0 0 0 4 21h16a2 2 0 0 0 1.73-3" />
                <path d="M12 9v4" />
                <path d="M12 17h.01" />
              </svg>
            )}
            {tone === "circle-check" && (
              <svg className={styles.iconLucideInfoSvg6} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#0369A1" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
                <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" />
                <path d="m16 9-5.5 5.5L8 12" />
              </svg>
            )}
          </div>
          {detail && (
            <div className={styles.keterangan}>
              more
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Chip;

// Generated by Lakar from component "Baris". Import tokens.css once in your app.
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import { Chip } from './Chip';
import styles from './Baris.module.css';

export type BarisProps = {
  judul?: string;
  showChip?: boolean;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Baris({ judul = "Row", showChip = true, showIcon = false, className, style }: BarisProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.baris}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      {showIcon && (
        <div className={styles.iconLucideStar}>
          <svg className={styles.iconLucideStarSvg} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#CA8A04" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <path d="M11.525 2.295a.53.53 0 0 1 .95 0l2.31 4.679a2.123 2.123 0 0 0 1.595 1.16l5.166.756a.53.53 0 0 1 .294.904l-3.736 3.638a2.123 2.123 0 0 0-.611 1.878l.882 5.14a.53.53 0 0 1-.771.56l-4.618-2.428a2.122 2.122 0 0 0-1.973 0L6.396 21.01a.53.53 0 0 1-.77-.56l.881-5.139a2.122 2.122 0 0 0-.611-1.879L2.16 9.795a.53.53 0 0 1 .294-.906l5.165-.755a2.122 2.122 0 0 0 1.597-1.16z" />
          </svg>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className={styles.judul}>
        {judul}
      </div>
      {showChip && (
        <Chip label="nested" open={true} className={styles.chipDiBaris} />

    </div>
  );
}

export default Baris;
